question: An electronic digital caliper displays the measurement on a _____.
solution:
__**Explanation:**__

**Electronic Digital Caliper**

**Definition:** An electronic digital caliper is a precise measuring tool used to determine the dimensions of an object with high accuracy. It uses electronic components and a digital display to show the measurement readings, eliminating the need for manual interpretation of scales, as required in traditional calipers.

**Working Principle:** The electronic digital caliper operates by using a linear encoder system. When the jaws of the caliper move, the encoder detects the displacement and converts it into an electronic signal. This signal is then processed and displayed as a numerical value on the liquid crystal display (LCD) screen. The LCD screen enables the user to read measurements directly, offering convenience and accuracy.

**Advantages:**

 
• Provides highly accurate and precise measurements, often up to 0.01 mm or 0.0005 inches.
 
• Easy to use, as the measurements are displayed directly on the LCD screen, reducing chances of errors due to manual reading.
 
• Includes features such as metric/inch conversion, zero setting, and data output capabilities, improving its versatility.
